# P/GEN Design Profile Catalog

> 10,000 original P/GEN UI, typography, color, and interaction profiles. These are generated design combinations—not 10,000 GitHub repositories, brand systems, screenshots, or copied layouts. They are derived from the existing curated source principles and require original, accessible implementation.

## How to use this catalog

- Select profiles by product brief and task relevance; do not treat profile IDs as external dependencies.
- Use one primary visual direction and a small number of supporting profiles. Do not collage multiple unrelated aesthetics.
- Every profile still requires semantic tokens, contrast validation, responsive type, motion restraint, and accessibility.
- Profile selection in Gemini Forge is automatic by default and can be biased toward premium, editorial, enterprise, calm, or bold creative direction.
